title: Attic insulation in matched pairs of houses
intro: A utility tested a new attic insulation in a matched-pairs study. Twenty houses were put in ten pairs matched on floor area, age and orientation, and in each pair a coin decided which house was retrofitted. The heating energy over the winter (kWh per m² of floor) was then recorded for both. The two houses of a pair belong together, so the test is the paired t on the ten differences d = retrofitted − not retrofitted: H₀: μ_d = 0 against H₁: μ_d ≠ 0 at α = 0.05.
